name: STEAM Buddies for Teens
what_you_do: Be a big buddy to a child in grades 2 to 4 and try science, tech, art and math activities together each week with LEGO, Osmo, Sphero robots and more. Library staff train and support you.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 who live in Vancouver. You must come to every session.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. You earn community service hours.
duration: One hour a week for about 4 weeks, plus a teen training session on the first date.
deadline_text: All four Fall 2026 sessions (Champlain Heights, Kitsilano, Mount Pleasant, Terry Salman) were full on Oct 19, 2026. Apply at least one week before a session starts. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: When new sessions are posted, fill in the online form on the STEAM Buddies page at least one week before the start date. Questions: teens@vpl.ca.
notes: Like Reading Buddies, but with hands-on science and tech. Check the page each season for new branches and dates.
